description.value: Sashimi & Sushi Express is a fast-food sushi counter operating from unit 101c of a commercial building. The Instagram handle references Surrey, suggesting a quick-service Japanese food stop in the Fraser Valley corridor. It represents a convenient option for touring cyclists looking for a light, protein-rich meal on the go.
